title: Field visit: Kothmale hydropower station
excerpt: A rare first-hand look at one of Sri Lanka’s significant hydroelectric power stations and its dam.
content: The field visit to the Kothmale Hydro Power Station and dam gave participants first-hand experience of one of Sri Lanka’s significant hydroelectric power stations — with in-depth discussions on its operations, its importance to the national grid and the engineering behind large-scale hydroelectric generation.
